decks.notes: This Grixis Aggro deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Thoughtseize and Nihil Spellbomb while applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Murktide Regent and Nethergoyf. The deck also includes versatile cards like Consign to Memory and Molten Collapse to control the board and finish off opponents. With a mix of efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Force of Will for protection, this deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent in a fast-paced Legacy format.

The main focus of this Dimir Tempo deck is to control the opponent's board while applying pressure with efficient creatures like Murktide Regent and Nethergoyf. Utilizing disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will, along with countermagic such as Daze, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining a fast tempo. The deck also includes disruptive tools like Wasteland and Nihil Spellbomb to further disrupt the opponent's resources. Additionally, Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides card advantage and utility to help the deck maintain its tempo advantage.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the necessary combo pieces to mill your own library, while also generating mana through cards like Lotus Petal and Simian Spirit Guide. Once you have milled yourself enough, you can use cards like Thassa's Oracle or Dread Return to win the game. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Pact of Negation and Cabal Therapy to protect your combo. Overall, the goal is to combo off quickly and win the game before your opponent can stop you.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying constant pressure with aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets and Murktide Regent. The deck aims to control the game tempo using disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will, while also utilizing efficient removal spells such as Fatal Push. The deck also includes card draw and filtering options like Brainstorm and Ponder to ensure consistency. The land base is optimized for fetching and mana fixing, allowing the deck to operate smoothly and effectively in the Legacy format.

This deck focuses on maintaining control of the game through disruption spells like Thoughtseize and counter spells like Force of Will, while also deploying threats like Murktide Regent and Brazen Borrower to pressure the opponent's life total. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while efficiently deploying threats and generating card advantage through cards like Brainstorm and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. The mana denial strategy with Wasteland and tempo plays with cards like Daze also play a key role in slowing down the opponent's game plan, allowing this deck to dictate the pace of the game.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize cards like Mystic Forge, Grim Monolith, and Manifold Key to generate infinite mana, allowing for continuous plays and combos. The deck focuses on tutoring for key pieces with Urza's Saga and using artifacts like Glaring Fleshraker and Planar Nexus to control the board. Karn, the Great Creator provides additional utility and disruption while Urza's Tower and Ancient Tomb help to ramp up mana production. Overall, the deck aims to establish a dominant board presence and overwhelm the opponent with powerful combos.

The deck utilizes the Show and Tell combo to cheat out powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Archon of Cruelty early in the game, overwhelming opponents. It includes cards like Sneak Attack and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to further support this strategy, along with counter spells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce for protection. The deck also includes a variety of lands and card draw spells to ensure consistency in executing the combo. Overall, the key concept revolves around quickly and efficiently getting big creatures into play to secure victory.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Brainstorm, then reanimating them onto the battlefield with cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. By utilizing counterspells like Force of Will and Daze, the deck aims to protect its combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's strategies. The strategy revolves around efficiently assembling the combo pieces to bring out threats like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier early in the game, overwhelming the opponent with powerful creatures and controlling the board with cards like Wasteland and Fatal Push.

The deck focuses on utilizing Gaea's Cradle and mana dorks to ramp up quickly and efficiently, with the goal of generating a large amount of mana to cast powerful green creatures and spells. It also incorporates cards like Endurance and Misty Rainforest for graveyard interaction and deck thinning, as well as control elements like Sylvan Safekeeper and Collector Ouphe to disrupt opponents. The inclusion of cards like Natural Order and Craterhoof Behemoth allows for explosive finishes, making it a versatile and adaptable control deck in Legacy format.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the card Mystic Forge in combination with various mana acceleration cards like Grim Monolith and Ancient Tomb to quickly assemble a powerful combination of artifacts such as Karn, the Great Creator and The One Ring. The goal is to generate a significant amount of mana to cast and activate multiple cards in a single turn, ultimately overwhelming the opponent with a powerful board presence and unexpected combos. The inclusion of cards like Urza's Saga and Planar Nexus also add consistency and utility to the deck's overall strategy.

This deck focuses on using aggressive creatures like Broadside Bombardiers and Laelia, the Blade Reforged, along with powerful spells like Blood Moon and Sundering Eruption to quickly disrupt the opponent's game plan and close out the game before they can stabilize. The deck takes advantage of mana acceleration from cards like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide to power out its threats early and overwhelm the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Magus of the Moon and The One Ring further disrupts the opponent's ability to cast spells and allows the deck to push through for victory.

This deck utilizes Mystic Forge along with artifacts like Grim Monolith, Basalt Monolith, and Voltaic Key to generate infinite mana and draw through the entire deck. Urza's Saga and Urza's Tower help produce additional mana to fuel the combo. Karn, the Great Creator can shut down opponents' artifacts while also finding key pieces for the combo. The One Ring provides a win condition by casting spells for free once infinite mana has been generated. Planar Nexus can be used to take extra turns, ensuring victory once the combo is online.

This deck revolves around assembling the Mystic Forge combo with cards like Grim Monolith, Manifold Key, and Voltaic Key to generate infinite mana and card advantage. Karn, the Great Creator helps find important artifacts, while Glaring Fleshraker and Kozilek's Command provide alternative win conditions. The key strategy is to quickly ramp into the combo pieces using Ancient Tomb and Urza's Saga, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Pithing Needle and Vexing Bauble. The synergy between artifacts and lands like Planar Nexus and Urza's Tower ensures a powerful and consistent combo deck.

The deck focuses on quickly dropping powerful creatures onto the battlefield by using cards like Show and Tell and Sneak Attack. The goal is to get cards like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn or Archon of Cruelty into play as early as possible to overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes counterspells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce to protect its combo pieces. In addition, cards like Atraxa, Grand Unifier provide additional value and support to the combo strategy. Overall, the deck aims to win the game through explosive combos and high-impact creatures.

The main concept of this Legacy 1 vs 1 combo-Reanimator deck is to utilize cards like Entomb, Reanimate, and Psychic Frog to quickly bring powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Archon of Cruelty onto the battlefield. The deck includes disruption tools like Force of Will, Daze, and Thoughtseize to protect the combo pieces and control the opponent's game plan. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides card advantage and filtering, while Fatal Push and Orcish Bowmasters deal with opposing threats. The mana base is optimized with fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistency and flexibility in casting spells.

This deck focuses on generating mana quickly through rituals and mana-producing artifacts to cast a high number of spells in a single turn. The key strategy is to create a large storm count, which is a mechanic that counts the number of spells cast during a turn, in order to win the game with a powerful finisher like Tendrils of Agony or Burning Wish for a lethal spell. The deck includes card draw, discard, and protection spells to help achieve this combo win condition efficiently and effectively.
